key_evidence_spans: A 60‐year‐old tailor with no significant medical history presented with a 3‐year history of macerated skin between his toes
painful, fissured ulcer at the base of the fourth interdigital space of the right foot
had received multiple antifungal regimens—including topical sertaconazole for 6 weeks and oral terbinafine 250 mg daily for 6 weeks—without improvement
Dermoscopy revealed unstructured whitish areas and hyperkeratosis
verrucous, infected ulceration with infiltrated, hyperkeratotic edges
hyperkeratotic edges and a whitish, fissured base measuring 3 cm in diameter
